name: @factstack/emit-browser
description: Browser-side artifact emitter: writeBrowserArtifacts() materializes .facts/{agent.json, human.json, agent.pack, agent.jsonl, snapshots/} into a FileSystemDirectoryHandle (FSA) the user picks, plus browserGzip() via CompressionStream so the bundle-size estimator works without node:zlib. Mirrors @factstack/emit's surface where the work is the same; diverges only at the I/O + compression boundary.
